taglines: It is Friday which is the day the week technically ends but you stopped caring about the week on Wednesday and you have been coasting on that decision ever since and today is just the universe catching up to where you already were emotionally and it feels correct.

You are halfway through a task that you estimated would take twenty minutes and it has been forty-five minutes and you have not revised the estimate because revising the estimate means confronting the estimate and you are not there yet you are still in the part where it might just take twenty minutes.

June is almost over which means summer is technically underway but you have not done the summer thing you told yourself you would do and the window is now narrow enough that doing the thing would feel like a response to the window closing rather than an authentic choice and you have standards about that.

Someone is going to send you a message today that says 'quick question' and it will not be a quick question and you will answer it thoroughly and they will say 'thanks!' and that will be the whole transaction and you will feel the mild injustice of this for approximately ninety seconds before letting it go completely.

Your browser has seventeen tabs open and three of them are things you genuinely need and fourteen of them are ambient intentions that have hardened into furniture and at this point closing them would feel more disruptive than leaving them and so they stay and you work around them like they are structural.

At some point this week you said 'I'll circle back to that' and you meant it sincerely in the moment and the moment is gone and the circling back is now a vague debt that has no due date and no creditor and lives entirely in the part of your brain that activates right before you fall asleep and says hey.

There is a version of you that wakes up at 6am and exercises and journals and that version is not fake it is just running on a different fork of your life that diverged at a decision you made years ago without knowing it was a decision and this version is doing fine actually and has opinions about everything.

Today is a good day to do the thing you have been telling yourself you'll do when conditions are right and conditions are approximately right right now and they are not going to get more right they are just going to become different wrong and this is the window and the window has a face and it is looking at you.
